allow: Shell(powershell -NoProfile -Command "Get-ChildItem -Path . -Recurse -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.LastWriteTime -gt (Get-Date).AddMinutes(-3) } | Select-Object -First 30 FullName, LastWriteTime | Format-Table -AutoSize")

Shell(powershell -NoProfile -Command "Get-ChildItem 'dist\client\_astro\*.css' | ForEach-Object { $c = Get-Content $_.FullName -Raw; if ($c -match 'blue-gray') { \"$($_.Name): blue-gray FOUND\" } else { \"$($_.Name): no blue-gray\" } }")

Shell(powershell -NoProfile -Command "$c = Get-Content 'dist\client\es\index.html' -Raw; @('experience','Chip','Timeline','Ver Portafolio','Enviar Mensaje') | ForEach-Object { if ($c -match [regex]::Escape($_)) { \"FOUND: $_\" } else { \"MISSING: $_\" } }")

Shell(powershell -NoProfile -Command "$c = Get-Content 'dist\client\es\index.html' -Raw; $m = [regex]::Matches($c, 'astro-island'); \"astro-island count: $($m.Count)\"; $m2 = [regex]::Matches($c, 'client:only'); \"client:only count: $($m2.Count)\"; $c2 = Get-Content 'dist\client\es\index.html' -Raw; if ($c2 -match 'ExperienceTimeline') { 'ExperienceTimeline script FOUND' } else { 'NO ExperienceTimeline' }")

Shell(powershell -NoProfile -Command "$c = Get-Content 'node_modules\@material-tailwind\react\index.js' -Raw; if ($c -match 'ThemeProvider') { 'ThemeProvider IS exported' } else { 'NOT found as export' }")

Shell(powershell -NoProfile -Command "$c = Get-Content 'dist\es\index.html' -Raw -Encoding UTF8; @('E-commerce App','Task Manager Mobile','Enviar Mensaje','Nombre completo','Freelance','Desarrollador Full Stack','scanlines','gradient-bg') | ForEach-Object { if ($c -match [regex]::Escape($_)) { \"OK: $_\" } else { \"MISSING: $_\" } }")

Shell(powershell -NoProfile -Command "$p = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 4321 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 1 -ExpandProperty OwningProcess; if ($p) { \"PID: $p\"; Stop-Process -Id $p -Force -Confirm:$false; 'Stopped' } else { 'No listener' }")

Shell(powershell -NoProfile -Command "$p = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 4321 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 1 -ExpandProperty OwningProcess; if ($p) { Stop-Process -Id $p -Force -Confirm:$false; \"Stopped $p\" } else { 'No listener' }")

Shell(powershell -NoProfile -Command "Start-Sleep -Seconds 5; try { $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri 'http://localhost:4321/es/' -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 30; \"HTTP $($r.StatusCode) length $($r.Content.Length)\" } catch { if ($_.Exception.Response) { \"HTTP $([int]$_.Exception.Response.StatusCode)\" } else { \"ERR: $($_.Exception.Message)\" } }")

Shell(powershell -NoProfile -Command "Start-Sleep -Seconds 6; try { $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri 'http://localhost:4321/es/' -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 30; \"HTTP $($r.StatusCode) length $($r.Content.Length)\" } catch { if ($_.Exception.Response) { \"HTTP $([int]$_.Exception.Response.StatusCode)\" } else { \"ERR: $($_.Exception.Message)\" } }")

Shell(powershell -NoProfile -Command "Stop-Process -Id 17304 -Force -Confirm:$false; Start-Sleep -Seconds 1; $p = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 4321 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 1 -ExpandProperty OwningProcess; if ($p) { \"Still listening: $p\" } else { 'Port free' }")

Shell(powershell -NoProfile -Command "Start-Sleep -Seconds 8; try { $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri 'http://localhost:4321/es/' -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 40; \"HTTP $($r.StatusCode) length $($r.Content.Length)\" } catch { if ($_.Exception.Response) { \"HTTP $([int]$_.Exception.Response.StatusCode)\" } else { \"ERR: $($_.Exception.Message)\" } }")

Shell(powershell -NoProfile -Command "Start-Sleep -Seconds 10; try { $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri 'http://localhost:4321/es/' -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 40; \"HTTP $($r.StatusCode) length $($r.Content.Length)\" } catch { if ($_.Exception.Response) { \"HTTP $([int]$_.Exception.Response.StatusCode)\" } else { \"ERR: $($_.Exception.Message)\" } }")

Shell(powershell -NoProfile -Command "try { $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri 'http://localhost:4321/es/' -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 30; $c = $r.Content; @('E-commerce App','Enviar Mensaje','Nombre completo','Freelance','Desarrollador Full Stack','scanlines','gradient-bg','Experiencia') | ForEach-Object { if ($c -match [regex]::Escape($_)) { \"OK: $_\" } else { \"MISSING: $_\" } } } catch { \"ERR: $($_.Exception.Message)\" }")

Shell(powershell -NoProfile -Command "try { $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri 'http://localhost:4321/es/' -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 30; $c = $r.Content; $i = $c.IndexOf('astro-island'); if ($i -ge 0) { \"Has astro-island at $i\" } else { 'NO astro-island' }; $m = [regex]::Matches($c, 'astro-island'); \"Count: $($m.Count)\"; $j = $c.IndexOf('id=\"experience\"'); if ($j -ge 0) { 'Has experience section' } else { 'NO experience section' } } catch { \"ERR: $($_.Exception.Message)\" }")
